subject: planner: add physical plan memorization for multi cascades logical alternative. (#58832)
summary: Computes a bottom-up subtree hash (via logical plan node IDs) for each logical plan produced from cascades memo iteration and stores it on the logical plan nodes; namespaces `BaseLogicalPlan` task-map memoization keys with this hash so cached physical tasks don’t cross-contaminate across different logical alternatives assembled by the memo iterator.
